$schema_note: Machine-readable map of this repository for coding agents. Prose companion for Claude Code specifically is CLAUDE.md at repo root; this file is broader-purpose and tool-agnostic. Regenerate by re-deriving from source rather than hand-editing stale facts.

product.one_liner: AdSpace Horizon: a Bengaluru-focused marketplace for out-of-home (OOH) advertising space (hoardings, bus shelters, skywalks, digital OOH) connecting ad-space owners, advertisers, and a marketplace admin/ops team.
prd_files: AdSpace_Marketplace_PRD.html (title: 'AdSpace Marketplace - PRD v0.1'; gitignored, present on disk but not tracked in git)
personas: Advertiser (browses inventory, books space, orders add-ons)
Ad-space Owner (lists inventory, manages own listings)
Admin/Ops (approves listings, runs the VAS job queue) - only implemented in the legacy backend/
product.vas_meaning: Value-Added Services: printing, installation, maintenance/monitoring work related to an ad space. In legacy backend/ these are first-class VASOrder entities; in MVP/backend they are simplified to booking add-ons.

repo_shape.summary: Three generations of the same product live side by side. MVP/ is the current, deployed one (Next.js + a trimmed FastAPI). Ui_Prototype_MVP_Prep/ is the original static HTML prototype. backend/ is the fuller FastAPI service with the complete domain model (VAS orders, invoices, admin review, scraper) that MVP/backend was cut down from.
repo_shape.top_level_entry_point: index.html - meta-refresh redirect into Ui_Prototype_MVP_Prep/index.html (the old prototype landing page). Not what the Vercel deployment serves.
repo_shape.which_half_is_authoritative: For anything deployed, MVP/. For domain rules not yet ported (VAS lifecycle, admin listing review, invoices, notifications, audit log, scraper provenance), backend/.

directories.MVP/frontend/: Next.js 15.5.22 App Router + React 19 + Tailwind 3 frontend. The deployed UI. 2252 tracked files, most of them listing photography under public/images/.
directories.MVP/backend/: Trimmed FastAPI + SQLAlchemy 2 API that the deployed frontend talks to. 20 routes. Runs on Vercel as a serverless function via api/index.py.
directories.MVP/DEPLOY_VERCEL.md: Vercel deployment runbook for both MVP projects.
directories.MVP/IMPLEMENTATION_NOTES.md: Running notes on the MVP build.
directories.Ui_Prototype_MVP_Prep/: Original static HTML/CSS/Tailwind UI prototype. No build step, no bundler; open files directly or serve as static files. One hand-authored CSS file and Tailwind config per page under css/ and js/, not shared.
directories.backend/: Legacy/fuller FastAPI service. 26 routes, 10 entities, Alembic migrations, Docker Compose, and backend/docs/ (the most detailed prose docs in the repo). Not deployed.
directories.backend/scraper/: Standalone CLI that collects competitor OOH inventory into JSONL/CSV and optionally imports it as pending_approval listings. Imports from app.* but nothing in app/ imports it, and the API never invokes it.
directories..github/workflows/: deploy-pages.yml only. Root .gitignore excludes .github/* then re-includes workflows/, so other .github content stays local.
directories.index.html: Root redirect into the old prototype.

branches.landing-redesign: Active work. 4 commits ahead of main, main is a strict ancestor. Contains the night-register landing page rebuild, self-hosted fonts, and the mobile/tap-target passes.

frontend_mvp.stack: Next.js 15.5.22 (App Router, Turbopack in dev), React 19.1.0, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS 3.4 (+ @tailwindcss/forms, @tailwindcss/container-queries), zod 4 for wizard schemas. No component library.

env_vars.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL: API base. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1 in src/lib/api.ts. On Vercel it is the relative /api/v1, proxied by vercel.json to the backend project, so the browser only ever talks to one origin and CORS is out of the picture.
env_vars.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH: '/OOH_Marketplace' for the GitHub Pages project site, '' otherwise.
env_vars.NEXT_OUTPUT: Set to 'export' for the static build.
env_vars.NEXT_DIST_DIR: Keeps the dev build output out of .next so a dev server and a production build can coexist.
env_vars.NEXT_EXPORT_LISTING_IDS: Limits which listing detail pages are pre-rendered, for faster local export runs.

route_groups.(app): /analytics, /cart, /checkout, /list-your-space (5-step wizard: location, details, pricing, availability, review)

frontend_mvp.build_scale: 2133 pre-rendered pages, of which 2114 are /listings/[id] via generateStaticParams reading the static snapshot.

key_libs.src/lib/api.ts: fetch wrapper; reads NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL, attaches the bearer token.
key_libs.src/lib/listings-source.ts: Tries the API first, falls back to public/data/*.json. The fallback only triggers on a transport failure - a 4xx/5xx from a reachable API is surfaced, not masked with stale data. Its filter/sort logic mirrors browse_listings in MVP/backend/app/main.py; change one and change the other.
key_libs.src/lib/wizard/: Reducer, zod schema, context and payload mapper for the list-your-space wizard.
key_libs.src/lib/pages-image-loader.ts: Image loader for the basePath-prefixed static export.

fonts.rule: All four faces (Epilogue, Manrope, Inter, Syne) load through next/font/local from committed woff2 files in src/app/fonts/. Do NOT move them back to next/font/google.
fonts.why: next/font/google fetches the files during next build, so a build machine that cannot reach fonts.gstatic.com fails the entire build - which is how the Vercel deploy broke once.
fonts.detail: Each file is the latin variable face, so one file covers a family's whole weight range. Material Symbols is still a runtime <link> in layout.tsx, which is a browser request rather than a build-time one and therefore cannot break a build.

landing_page.design_register: Its own 'night' register - two light temperatures only (amber --color-accent against near-black #05070f), with the photography carrying the rest of the colour. Display type is Syne; Manrope on body, Inter on data/labels.
landing_page.nav: NavShellA renders unpainted and fixed over the hero on / only, and paints its white bar once scrollY > 64.
landing_page.signature_element: components/marketing/HeroSlots.tsx - a play-out loop mirroring how digital OOH sells a rotation. The fill-bar duration lives in TWO places: SLOT_MS there and the slot-fill keyframe in globals.css. Change both together.
landing_page.motion: Scroll entrances go through components/marketing/Reveal.tsx; every animation is neutralised under prefers-reduced-motion.
landing_page.copy_is_data_backed: Section copy quotes the real catalogue and the format tiles deep-link into /marketplace?space_type=... Re-check the numbers whenever the static snapshot is regenerated.
landing_page.imagery_policy: Real photographs with free commercial-use licensing only - no AI-generated imagery. Provenance is recorded in MVP/frontend/public/images/CREDITS.md.

frontend_mvp.verification_expectations: Frontend changes are expected to be checked with real interaction tests (a CDP harness driving actual routes), not just a passing build: horizontal overflow at 360/390/414px, runtime JS errors, keyboard focus, prefers-reduced-motion, and hero fit at 1024/1280/1440/1920.

backend_mvp.stack: FastAPI 0.140, SQLAlchemy 2.0.51 (Mapped/mapped_column style), Alembic 1.18, Pydantic Settings, python-jose JWT, passlib+bcrypt, slowapi rate limiting, psycopg 3 for Postgres.

modules.app/main.py: All 20 routes, authorization checks, workflow orchestration.
modules.app/models.py: User, Listing, CartItem, Booking, Payment + Role/ListingStatus/BookingStatus/PaymentStatus enums.
modules.app/config.py: Settings. sqlalchemy_url rewrites postgres://|postgresql:// to postgresql+psycopg:// because hosted providers hand out the bare scheme and SQLAlchemy would otherwise reach for psycopg2, which is not installed.
modules.api/index.py: Vercel serverless entrypoint. Puts the package root on sys.path and re-exports app. Deployment glue only - uvicorn app.main:app locally stays the source of truth.

settings_env_vars.database_url: sqlite:///./adspace_mvp.db by default. Use a provider's POOLED Postgres endpoint in production - serverless opens many short-lived connections.

entities.Listing: owner_id, title, space_type, description, location, width_ft/height_ft (NULLABLE), price_per_day, footfall_estimate, status, rejection_reason, lighting, image_url, extra (JSON).
entities.Booking: listing_id, advertiser_id, date window, base_amount, addons_amount, addons, gst_amount, total_amount, status.
entities.Payment: user_id, booking_ids (JSON), amount, status, provider_order_id (unique), method_label (default 'Dummy Card').

pricing.money_type: Float in the schema. Not yet safe for real settlement.

backend_mvp.tests: MVP/backend/tests: test_auth, test_cart, test_checkout, test_listings. conftest.py builds a fresh in-memory SQLite DB per test and overrides the FastAPI DB dependency.

backend_legacy.status: Not deployed. Still the most complete expression of the domain and the only place several workflows exist. Keep as reference; do not assume the deployed API has these routes.
extra_capabilities: Owner listing status transitions and document upload
VAS order lifecycle: unassigned -> scheduled -> in_progress -> completed, or cancelled
app/integrations.py: GST validation, Google Maps geocoding, S3/local file storage, SMTP, invoice PDF generation - thin adapters, each falling back to a no-op/local behaviour when unconfigured
backend_legacy.pricing_differs: VAS is priced per unit (printing 25, installation 1500, maintenance 750) rather than as the flat MVP add-on catalogue. GST is 18% over base+VAS in both.
backend_legacy.payment_warning: POST /payments/{id}/confirm is a development-only simulated endpoint, disabled when APP_ENV=production. There is no real payment gateway webhook. Never wire a frontend confirm button to production traffic against it.

entity_lifecycles.Listing: pending_approval -> active|rejected; active can be paused/resumed
entity_lifecycles.VASOrder: unassigned -> scheduled -> in_progress -> completed, or cancelled. May be linked to a booking or standalone.

backend_legacy.architecture_note: Flat module set - no service or repository layer. app/main.py holds routes, authorization, pricing math and workflow orchestration. alembic/ is the only path allowed to change the schema; the schema is never created via create_all().
backend_legacy.docker: docker compose up --build -d runs alembic upgrade head then Uvicorn. Requires APP_ENV=production, a real DATABASE_URL, a 32+ char SECRET_KEY, and restrictive CORS_ORIGINS/ALLOWED_HOSTS.
known_gaps_before_public_launch: Money stored as Float rather than Decimal

scraper.purpose: Collect competitor OOH inventory into JSONL/CSV and optionally import it as pending_approval listings.
commands: python -m scraper.cli scrape themediaant --location 'Bangalore, Karnataka, India' --location-id 'ChIJbU60yXAWrjsR4E9-UejD3_g' --images --out data/bangalore
scraper.deps: beautifulsoup4 + lxml; playwright only for scraper/browser.py, which is for sites that build their listings client-side (themediaant does not).
scraper.provenance: Scraped rows land in listings as pending_approval under a synthetic scraped-inventory@internal.invalid owner, with provenance in scraped_listings (unique source_url, so re-imports update in place).
scraper.rule: Never auto-approve scraped rows - they go through the same admin review as owner submissions.
scraper.adapter_convention: Adapters live in scraper/adapters/; everything shared (HTTP politeness, parsing, images, output) sits outside them. An adapter that can report expected_counts() lets the CLI reconcile a run against the source's own totals - on sites with unstable pagination that is the only way to know a run finished. Per-site quirks go in scraper/README.md, not just the adapter docstring.

marketplace_browse_contract.GET /listings: Returns a PAGED ENVELOPE {items, total, limit, offset}, not a bare list - a real city catalogue is thousands of rows.
marketplace_browse_contract.GET /listings/facets: Returns dropdown options (space_types, lightings, sizes, price_min, price_max, total) derived from live inventory. The UI must read filter options from it rather than hardcoding lists that drift from the data. Declared BEFORE /listings/{listing_id} so the literal path wins.
marketplace_browse_contract.nullable_dimensions: Listing.width_ft/height_ft are nullable. Real inventory does not always publish a size - bus shelters are sold by a Small/Medium/Large bucket kept in extra.size_bucket. Anything rendering dimensions must degrade rather than print 'null x null'.

catalogue_snapshot.regenerate_when: The catalogue changes - otherwise the deployed static site keeps showing old inventory, and the landing-page copy that quotes these numbers goes stale.

vercel.role: The real deployment. Writes work, so login/cart/checkout work.
vercel.projects: Frontend and backend are SEPARATE Vercel projects rooted at MVP/frontend and MVP/backend, under the same Vercel team.
vercel.backend_runtime: Serverless function via api/index.py, configured by MVP/backend/vercel.json (version 2 builds/routes form - the rewrites form collapsed every request to one path and broke FastAPI routing).
vercel.single_origin: MVP/frontend/vercel.json rewrites /api/v1/:path* to the backend deployment, so the browser only talks to one host and CORS is out of the picture.
vercel.database: Postgres on Neon. Use the pooled endpoint.
vercel.vercelignore: MVP/frontend/.vercelignore excludes out/ (the ~115 MB Pages export) - a plain CLI deploy aborted on it repeatedly.
vercel.allowed_hosts_gotcha: ALLOWED_HOSTS needs *.vercel.app. Starlette only suffix-matches a pattern that starts with '*', so a bare .vercel.app matches nothing and every request returns 400 Invalid host header.
vercel.root_directory_gotcha: Both projects set a Root Directory inside MVP/. Any branch that predates MVP/ fails at checkout with 'The specified Root Directory does not exist'. Do not push long-lived branches forked from before MVP/ existed.

github_pages.role: Read-only mirror. Static host, no backend; booking and checkout still need a real API.
github_pages.triggers: push to branch MVP touching MVP/frontend/** or the workflow itself, plus workflow_dispatch.
github_pages.build: npm ci then npm run build:pages with NEXT_OUTPUT=export, NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH from actions/configure-pages, NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL from the repository variable of the same name (a variable, not a secret - it is baked into the client bundle and therefore public either way).
github_pages.notes: touch out/.nojekyll guards against a future switch to branch-based Pages stripping _next/. static_site_generator is deliberately not set on configure-pages because the repo sets basePath itself.

frontend_backend_wiring.mvp: MVP/frontend talks to MVP/backend through src/lib/api.ts and src/lib/listings-source.ts. This is the live integration.
frontend_backend_wiring.legacy_prototype: Ui_Prototype_MVP_Prep/js/api.js is the only integration point on the old prototype: a tiny api(path, options) helper reading window.OOH_API_BASE_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1), attaching the JWT from localStorage key adspace_access_token, throwing on non-OK. login_Page.html is the only page wired to it. Every other prototype page is presentation-only. Mapping for wiring more pages is in backend/docs/FRONTEND.md.
frontend_backend_wiring.secrets_rule: Never put secrets or provider keys in frontend JS. The API is the only caller of external providers (Maps, GST, SMTP, S3).
